## Motivation

Forward inline MP4 blocks from Messages user content into the existing Chat `video_url` path. Preserve their position around text and tool results for both streaming and non-streaming requests.

This is a SGLang extension, not an Anthropic API type. Accept only base64 MP4 in top-level user content; reject unsupported sources/locations and video token counting, whose text-only result would undercount. The served model still needs a video-capable processor. K3's model-side video support remains in #35325; this adapter does not duplicate or provide that foundation.

## Test Plan

The new conversion regression fails on the base protocol and passes with the fix. Focused existing Messages tests also pass, covering both response modes, ordering, source validation, forbidden locations, token-count rejection and tool-result/reference compatibility. These are actual protocol/adapter tests with synthetic encoded payloads; MP4 decoding and full video-model generation are not exercised. Focused lint/formatting pass.

Prepared with Codex assistance.

 <Note>
 No preset has a full serving round on final weights; the constants derive from measured single- and dual-node rounds plus a 64-GPU sweep. Validate throughput and accuracy on your workload before committing a fleet.
 </Note>
+
+
+## Inline MP4 through Messages
+
+SGLang's Messages adapter accepts the following extension in top-level user
+content and forwards it to the served model's normal Chat video processor:
+
+```json
+{
+  "type": "video",
+  "source": {"type": "base64", "media_type": "video/mp4", "data": "<base64 MP4 bytes>"}
+}
+```
+
+This is a SGLang extension, not an Anthropic API content type. It requires a
+video-capable model and processor. K3's underlying Chat video support is tracked
+in [#35325](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35325); the adapter does not
+add that model support itself. Only inline MP4 is accepted; system/assistant
+video, video nested inside tool results, and video token counting are rejected.
+Text, video and tool-result order is preserved in both response modes.

@@ -65,6 +65,28 @@ class ImageBlock(BaseModel):

+        if not value.strip():

+
+
+class VideoBlock(BaseModel):
+    """SGLang extension accepted only in a user message's top-level content."""
+
+    type: Literal["video"] = "video"

+def _contains_video_block(content: Any) -> bool:
+    if not isinstance(content, list):
+        return False
+    for block in content:
+        if isinstance(block, dict):
+            block_type, nested_content = block.get("type"), block.get("content")
+        else:
+            block_type = getattr(block, "type", None)
+            nested_content = getattr(block, "content", None)
+        if block_type == "video" or _contains_video_block(nested_content):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
 class AnthropicMessage(BaseModel):
     role: Literal["user", "assistant", "system"]
     content: Union[str, list[AnthropicContentBlock]]
 
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _validate_video_location(self):
+        if isinstance(self.content, list):
+            for block in self.content:
+                if (block.type == "video" and self.role != "user") or (
+                    _contains_video_block(getattr(block, "content", None))
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Video input is supported only in top-level user content; "
+                        "system, assistant and nested tool_result video are not supported"
+                    )
+        return self

     output_config: Optional[AnthropicOutputConfig] = None

+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _reject_video_count(self):
+        # This endpoint counts the text template without running the video
+        # processor, so accepting video would return an understated count.
+        if _contains_video_block(self.system) or any(

@@ -192,6 +193,115 @@ def _tool_result_request(self, content, tools=None):
             overrides["tools"] = tools

+    @staticmethod
+    def _video_block(data="Zmlyc3Q="):
+        return {
+            "type": "video",
+            "source": {"type": "base64", "media_type": "video/mp4", "data": data},
+        }
+
+    def test_inline_mp4_preserves_media_and_tool_result_order(self):
+        """The SGLang extension must reach the shared Chat adapter without losing
+        video or moving it across a tool_result in either response mode."""
+        for stream in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(stream=stream):
+                request = self._anthropic_request(
+                    stream=stream,
+                    messages=[
+                        {
+                            "role": "user",
+                            "content": [
+                                {"type": "text", "text": "before"},
+                                self._video_block(),
+                                {
+                                    "type": "tool_result",
+                                    "tool_use_id": "call_x",
+                                    "content": "ok",
+                                },
+                                self._video_block("c2Vjb25k"),
+                                {"type": "text", "text": "after"},
+                            ],
+                        }
+                    ],
+                )
+                converted = self._serving()._convert_to_chat_completion_request(request)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [m.role for m in converted.messages], ["user", "tool", "user"]
+                )
+                parts_before = converted.messages[0].content
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [part.type for part in parts_before], ["text", "video_url"]
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(parts_before[0].text, "before")
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    parts_before[1].video_url.url, "data:video/mp4;base64,Zmlyc3Q="
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(converted.messages[1].tool_call_id, "call_x")
+                self.assertEqual(converted.messages[1].content, "ok")
+                parts_after = converted.messages[2].content
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [part.type for part in parts_after], ["video_url", "text"]
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    parts_after[0].video_url.url, "data:video/mp4;base64,c2Vjb25k"
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(parts_after[1].text, "after")
+                self.assertEqual(converted.stream, stream)
+
+    def test_inline_mp4_source_rejects_url_wrong_mime_and_empty_data(self):
+        for source in (
+            {"type": "url", "url": "https://example.com/video.mp4"},
+            {"type": "base64", "media_type": "video/webm", "data": "Zmlyc3Q="},
+            {"type": "base64", "media_type": "video/mp4", "data": ""},
+            {"type": "base64", "media_type": "video/mp4", "data": "  "},
+            {"type": "base64", "media_type": "video/mp4"},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(source=source), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                self._anthropic_request(
+                    messages=[
+                        {
+                            "role": "user",
+                            "content": [{"type": "video", "source": source}],
+                        }
+                    ]
+                )
+
+    def test_inline_mp4_rejects_system_assistant_and_nested_tool_content(self):
+        for role in ("system", "assistant"):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(role=role),
+                self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "top-level user"),
+            ):
+                self._anthropic_request(
+                    messages=[{"role": role, "content": [self._video_block()]}]
+                )
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "top-level user"):
+            self._anthropic_request(system=[self._video_block()])
+        for nested in (
+            [self._video_block()],
+            [
+                {
+                    "type": "tool_result",
+                    "tool_use_id": "inner",
+                    "content": [self._video_block()],
+                }
+            ],
+        ):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(nested=nested),
+                self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                    ValueError, "top-level user|Unsupported tool_result.content"
+                ),
+            ):
+                self._tool_result_request(nested)
+
+    def test_inline_mp4_count_tokens_rejected_before_text_only_count(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "count_tokens does not support video"):
+            AnthropicCountTokensRequest(
+                model="test-model",
+                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [self._video_block()]}],
+            )
+
     def test_messages_preserves_pd_rendezvous_through_native_conversion(self):
         """PD routers inject bootstrap fields into /v1/messages bodies; dropping
         them in the Chat Completions conversion strands the decode request."""
